# New Hope Orphanage

> New Hope Orphanage is a child-support organization in Cameroon dedicated to helping children grow in a safe, caring, and supportive environment through care, education, guidance, and opportunities for a brighter future.

New Hope Orphanage serves children in Cameroon, with work in Yaoundé and Douala.

The organization welcomes individuals, volunteers, businesses, associations, and other partners who want to support its mission and contribute to better opportunities for children.

The official website is https://newhopeorphanage.org/

## About New Hope Orphanage

- [About Us](https://newhopeorphanage.org/about-us): Information about New Hope Orphanage, its mission, values, and commitment to children in Cameroon.
- [Contact](https://newhopeorphanage.org/contact): Contact New Hope Orphanage for questions, volunteering, partnerships, and other inquiries.

## Supporting Children

- [Donate](https://newhopeorphanage.org/donate): Information about ways to support New Hope Orphanage and contribute to its mission.
- [Services](https://newhopeorphanage.org/): Information about the support and activities provided by New Hope Orphanage.

- [FAQs](https://newhopeorphanage.org/faqs): Answers to common questions about New Hope Orphanage, donations, volunteering, partnerships, and supporting children in Cameroon.
